title: Gap score backtest
summary: The solver gap score did not rank the open problems that upstream later tagged solved.
plot_title: AUC of the gap score against later resolution at four formal-conjectures snapshots, 0.5 is chance
discussion: Each open problem was scored with data from its snapshot date, then labelled by its tag at upstream 137aec5c on 2026-09-30. AUC ran 0.58, 0.58, 0.53 and 0.44. Docstring length beat the score at all four dates. A 32-feature metadata model trained on December 2025 and tested on June 2026 reached 0.54, interval 0.49 to 0.60. Wording similarity to a solved problem is a weak guide to what gets solved next. Next: features from the Lean statement and from prover attempts.
image_alt: Four points with intervals: AUC 0.58, 0.58, 0.53, 0.44 against a dashed line at 0.5
